_note: SCHEMATIC EXAMPLE ONLY. China is portal-gated with no open bulk: the GSXT register (SAMR) requires real-name auth + per-query CAPTCHA (no open API/bulk; often unreachable externally), so identity values here are PLACEHOLDERS, not copied from any record. USCC is the 18-char company id and also the taxpayer id (no separate VAT). Financials are open only for listed issuers (cninfo/SSE/SZSE, CNY, ASBE) — shown empty here. Legal-representative name is personal data (PIPL) and is redacted.
